headings.text: Wedding Party Shuttle Orange County | Deluxe Limousine Service

paragraphs: Wedding transportation should be effortless. Our Orange County wedding party shuttle service is designed to transport your guests and members of your wedding party and family in comfort and style. Deluxe Limousine Service has the experience and expertise to transport your guests and family to venues located at the finest hotels, country clubs, private estates, and beach and church venues.

Our Orange County wedding party shuttle moves bridesmaids, groomsmen, and family members between hotels, salons, churches, and reception venues — comfortably and on time. Many couples combine the shuttle with a [wedding limo service](/anaheim/wedding-limo-service/) so the bride and groom arrive in separate style.

We map every stop ahead of time, handle coastal traffic with buffer built into the schedule, and keep guest pickup stress-free all day. For the reception exit, upgrade to a [limousine service Orange County](/orange/limousine-service/) for the getaway ride.
